constraint: No new concepts created. No renderer changes. Ontology minimization is the primary goal.

concepts.name: Coverage Basin
concepts.description: Which pixels in the declared film domain were evaluated at all. Foundational — no other concept is its prerequisite.

concepts.name: Closure Basin
concepts.description: Which evaluated pixels converged to a terminal classification within the declared step budget. The Observatory's central diagnostic concept.

concepts.name: Ownership Basin
concepts.description: Which receiver zone claimed each ray after terminal classification. Defined only within the Closure Basin interior.

concepts.name: Cost Basin
concepts.description: How many traversal steps were required at each pixel to reach terminal classification. Defined only within the Closure Basin interior.
concepts.observer_language_v1_panel: Panel 6 — Traversal steps; Panel 7 — Budget stress

concepts.name: Disagreement Basin
concepts.description: Where two Ownership Basins assign different terminal classifications to the same pixel. Requires two named perspectives.

concepts.name: Sensitivity Basin
concepts.artifact_maturity_note: Curvature Signature instance is Characterized/4; generalized form is Proposed/0
concepts.description: Where the observation space responds measurably to a named parameter change. Signed delta of two Cost Basins.
concepts.observer_language_v1_panel: Panel 8 — Sensitivity Signature; xPRIMEray instance: Curvature Signature

concepts.name: Risk Nodes
concepts.description: Complement of Closure Basin within Coverage Basin interior. A derived set, not a basin. No sub-derivations.
concepts.note: NOT a seventh basin. Risk Nodes are a derived set expressed as Coverage_Basin_interior ∖ Closure_Basin_interior.

concepts.name: Coherence Basin
concepts.description: Topological stability criterion. Precision-invariant. Cannot be derived from a single run — requires a refinement sequence. Qualifies all six computational basins but is not contained by any.

concepts.name: Trust Model
concepts.description: Shared vocabulary for evidence strength. The 0–5 stage axis applies to all concepts and artifacts. Self-applicable. Crosswalk tables map Showcase Status, Citation Tiers, Xeno/Zeno Atlas Tiers, Archive Status, and Artifact Status onto the axis.

concepts.name: Adversarial Reviews
concepts.description: QA process that evaluates whether Observatory language makes unwarranted physical-truth claims. Applied to all Observatory-facing documents. Not produced by any basin; not required to compute any basin.

concepts.name: Observer Storyboard
concepts.description: Generalized 9-panel evidence framework. Schema-backed, renderer-agnostic. Panel 9 is Verdict (PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL/MISSING). Panels populated from basin outputs and Trust Model stages.

concepts.name: Observatory Storyboard
concepts.description: xPRIMEray-specific 9-panel contact sheet. An instance of Observer Storyboard. Panel names are xPRIMEray-specific labels over the Observer Storyboard framework. Does not define independent framework capabilities.
concepts.observer_language_v1_panel: xPRIMEray instance of Observer Storyboard panels
concepts.unique_role_note: An instance of Observer Storyboard, not a distinct concept.

concepts.name: Maturity Ladder
concepts.description: Thin presentation view of the Trust Model 0–5 scale. Unique content: Current Anchors table (per-artifact score assignments). Any scale changes must originate in the Trust Model.
concepts.unique_role_note: Trust Model already defines and owns the 0–5 scale. Maturity Ladder's only unique content is the Current Anchors table.

concepts.name: Basin Atlas
concepts.description: Compact reference card generated from reports/observatory_catalog.json. Relationship logic superseded by Basin Taxonomy v1. Retained as a generated artifact, not as the ontology source.
concepts.unique_role_note: Basin Taxonomy v1 supersedes its relationship logic. Basin Atlas is a generated view, not a source of truth.

concepts.name: Query Observatory
concepts.description: A single storyboard artifact instance produced from one run. Not a concept. No dedicated pipeline, catalog, or generation gate. Does not have architectural authority.
concepts.unique_role_note: An artifact instance, not a concept. Instance of Observatory Storyboard.

edges.description: Closure is defined only within the Coverage Basin interior
Ownership is undefined outside the Closure Basin interior
Cost is undefined outside the Closure Basin interior
Requires two Ownership Basins over the same Coverage interior; output is their symmetric difference
Requires two Cost Basins; pixel must be in both Closure Basins; output is signed arithmetic difference
Topological stability criterion applied to Coverage Basin results
Topological stability criterion applied to Closure Basin results
Topological stability criterion applied to Ownership Basin results
Topological stability criterion applied to Cost Basin results
Topological stability criterion applied to Disagreement Basin results
Topological stability criterion applied to Sensitivity Basin results
Maturity Ladder is a thin presentation view of the Trust Model 0–5 scale
Observatory Storyboard is the xPRIMEray-specific instance of Observer Storyboard
Query Observatory is one run artifact of Observatory Storyboard; not a concept
Basin Taxonomy v1 absorbs and supersedes Basin Atlas relationship logic; Basin Atlas is retained as generated reference
Adversarial Reviews evaluate whether Observer Storyboard language makes unwarranted physical-truth claims

notes: Computation chain is strictly directional: Coverage → Closure → {Ownership, Cost} → {Disagreement, Sensitivity}
No concept in the chain requires a concept downstream of it
Redundancy exists between Trust Model and Maturity Ladder (both define 0–5 scale) but this is redundancy, not circularity
Trust Model self-reference (Trust Model has its own maturity score) is self-reference, not circularity

minimum_concept_set.rationale: From these six, all other named concepts are either derived, presentation instances, a superseded reference, or a QA process. Disagreement and Sensitivity Basins are excluded because they require two instances of their parents — they are comparative, not foundational. Coherence Basin is excluded because it requires a refinement sequence — it qualifies the minimum set but is not a prerequisite for defining it.

concepts_without_unique_roles.recommendation: Retain as presentation view; do not extend independently. Scale changes must originate in Trust Model.
Retain as generated artifact; update generator to pull from Basin Taxonomy v1 rather than defining relationships directly.
Retain as instance definition; do not define new framework capabilities in it.
Retain as example artifact; do not promote to Maturity Ladder anchor unless a stable catalog or generation gate is established.

freeze_recommendations.reason: Characterized/4. Schema defined, artifacts generated per run, panel in Observer Storyboard v1, documented caveats. Observatory's central diagnostic concept. Renaming or redefining would invalidate all existing documentation.

The 0–5 stage vocabulary is referenced by all crosswalk tables, all gallery pages, and all artifact scores. Self-consistent with no known conflicts. Any change propagates to every downstream artifact label.
Schema-backed, renderer-agnostic, instantiated. Panel names locked in Observer Language v1. Adding panels would invalidate existing nine-panel artifacts.
